### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

### AI Meets Real Business Value at Strategy World 2027

Register early for just $895 ($600 in savings!)

[Learn More][11]

## The 5 traps of enterprise AI and how to escape them

These aren’t new problems. They’re the same data governance failures enterprises have faced for 35
years, now running at AI speed. Strategy has watched this pattern repeat itself across thousands of
deployments. The difference today is the stakes: your AI agents are making decisions  at scale, not
just reporting on them. Mosaic was built to close these gaps at the infrastructure level.

[extension_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The context gap

When AI doesn’t know what your business means. AI doesn’t know that “churn” means something specific
at your company. Without a semantic layer, they guess and sound confident while being wrong.

**Mosaic injects your business logic into every AI query before it runs. The model doesn’t just see
your data; it understands what it means.**

[filter_alt_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The logic silo problem

Business rules your AI can’t reach. When metrics live inside BI tools and spreadsheets, AI
agents can’t access them. Every agent reinvents the math inconsistently. 

**Mosaic decouples logic from consumption. One semantic layer governs dashboards, agents, and
applications simultaneously. Define once, apply everywhere.**

[calculate_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The accuracy trap

Why you can’t ask AI to do math. AI and large language models excel at language. They fail at
aggregation. Asking one to calculate quarterly revenue is a reliable path to hallucinated numbers. 

**Strategy handles the computation. AI handles the explanation. Accurate answers in natural language
without the risk of a model doing math it wasn’t designed for.**

[encrypted_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The security blindspot

What your AI agent can see that it shouldn’t. Most AI data tools bypass row-level security entirely.
A model that can access your data can also summarize it for the wrong person. 

**Every query through Mosaic passes through your existing RBAC rules before a single byte is
fetched. Governed AI isn’t a setting. It’s the architecture.**

[trending_down_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The cost trap

How ungoverned AI queries drain your cloud budget. AI agents that query raw data tables directly are
expensive by design. Each iteration against millions of rows compounds your compute spend invisibly,
until the bill arrives.

**Mosaic’s Smart Caching and push-down optimization routes every query intelligently. Your cloud
costs reflect your decisions, not your agents’ inefficiency.**

[01_Mosaic_Logo_Primary_Color.png]

#### Don’t be a statistic

Join the enterprises building their AI strategy on a governed, universal semantic layer.

[Learn more about Strategy Mosaic][12]

## Built for the entire organization

Mosaic delivers the unified data foundation needed to drive strategy, manage risk, and accelerate
delivery across the organization.

[MicroStrategy Video]
[Build your AI-ready foundation][13]

## The platform your enterprise AI is built on 

Strategy Mosaic is a universal semantic layer that unifies fragmented data systems into a consistent
framework, enabling humans and AI agents to work from a single, synchronized source of truth.

[verified_user_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48 (2).svg]

#### One governed layer for every system

Mosaic connects to 200+ data sources, cloud, on-prem, and hybrid, without moving a byte. Every agent
and application draws from the same governed, trusted definitions. AI that starts on solid ground.

[network_intel_node_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48 (2).svg]

#### From metric to action, in any interface

Because the semantic layer sits beneath every tool, the same governed logic powers dashboards, AI
agents, conversational queries, and embedded applications. One truth. Every surface.

[trending_down_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### Infrastructure-grade query efficiency

Mosaic’s push-down optimization and Smart Caching eliminate redundant processing at the source. The
result is predictable cloud spend even as AI query volume scales.

## What gets built when AI has a governed foundation 

Strategy Mosaic is the semantic layer that enterprise teams deploy once and build on
indefinitely. Here’s what becomes possible when your AI operates from a single, trusted source of
truth. 

**AI Agents with business context** 

Deploy agents that understand your definitions of revenue, churn, and risk, not generic
approximations. Built on Mosaic, agents use the same logic as your dashboards. 

**Self-service analytics at enterprise scale** 

Business users query governed data directly, in natural language or through dashboards, with no risk
of conflicting metrics or unauthorized access. 

**BI tool migration without logic loss** 

Replace Power BI, BOBJ, or Cognos without rebuilding your metrics. Business logic migrates to Mosaic
once then powers any BI tool you choose. 

**Embedded analytics in any application** 

Embed governed intelligence into your product, customer portal, or internal app. without exposing
the underlying data model or rebuilding access controls. 

## The semantic layer that connects your entire data ecosystem 

Strategy Mosaic sits beneath your existing stack, not on top of it. With 200+ native connectors to
every major cloud, warehouse, and lakehouse, governed semantics deploy instantly across Databricks,
Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, and beyond. No migration. No lock-in. Your data stays
where it is.

## FAQ

What is a universal semantic layer?

A universal semantic layer is the single source of truth for your organization's data definitions,
ensuring that 'Revenue' means exactly the same thing whether it's calculated in Salesforce, analyzed
in Tableau, or processed by your AI models. 

Sitting between your data sources and consumption tools, it translates raw data into trusted
business concepts like 'Active Customer' or 'Margin' with identical calculations and values
guaranteed across every team, every platform, and every use case.  

Unlike semantic layers trapped inside individual BI tools or data warehouses, a universal semantic
layer governs your entire data ecosystem, enforcing consistent definitions regardless of which
cloud, database, or application asks the question. No more finance reporting different numbers than
marketing. No more “Which dashboard is correct?”

How does Strategy Mosaic work?

Strategy Mosaic is a universal semantic layer that connects to your organization's data
sources: including Snowflake, Databrucks, BigQuery, Redshift, Azure, Synapse, SAP, Oracle,
Salesforce, Workday, and on-premises databases, without moving or replicating a single byte. 

Once connected, Mosaic Studio uses AI-powered modeling to automatically generate attributes,
hierarchies, and metrics from your data, delivering in hours what traditionally takes weeks of
manual work. Those definitions are then enforced across every connected BI tool, AI agent, and
application via SQL, DAX, MDX, and REST APIs: meaning Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and custom
applications all work from the same governed definitions automatically. 

Meanwhile, Mosaic Sentinel monitors your data ecosystem in real time, logging every access event,
flagging anomalies, detecting PII exposure, and maintaining a complete audit trail of who accessed
what data, when.

What are the benefits of Strategy Mosaic?
1. **Your Business Logic, Protected Across Every Platform and Every Change**: When your semantic
   layer is built into a single platform, your business definitions are only as portable as that
   vendor allows. Mosaic is a standalone, platform-agnostic layer that governs your definitions of
   Revenue, Margin, and Customer identically across every tool, every cloud, and every AI agent. And
   unlike newer semantic layer tools, Mosaic is backed by 35+ years of enterprise semantic
   technology, meaning it handles the complexity of real enterprise data: fiscal calendars,
   multi-currency hierarchies, time transformations, and security models that most tools are still
   building toward. Your logic is protected today, and it will still be intact when your
   infrastructure changes tomorrow. 
2. **The Only Semantic Layer Built for Everyone, Not Just Engineers**: Most semantic layers are
   built for data engineers and require SQL, YAML, or code to use. Mosaic Studio lets business users
   define new metrics in plain language, build and modify models without writing a single line of
   code, and govern data without filing a ticket. When business users can own their own definitions,
   your data team stops being a bottleneck and starts being a strategic asset. 
3. **Governance That Scales as Fast as Your AI:** As AI agents proliferate across your organization,
   the question isn't just "is my data accurate?" it's "Do I know what my AI accessed, at what cost,
   and whether it touched sensitive data?" Mosaic Sentinel answers all three in real time. It's the
   only semantic layer with governance intelligence built natively into the platform, not added
   on after the fact, giving you the confidence to scale AI without scaling risk.

How does Strategy Mosaic compare to semantic layers built into Snowflake or Databricks?

Snowflake and Databricks are exceptional data platforms. But their semantic layers are built to keep
you inside their ecosystem. Definitions created there don't travel cleanly to Tableau, Power BI, or
your AI agents without custom work.

Mosaic sits above your data platforms as an independent layer. Your definitions of Revenue, Margin,
and Customer are governed identically whether the query comes from a BI tool, an AI agent, or a
Python

Business rules your AI can’t reach. When metrics live inside BI tools and spreadsheets, AI
agents can’t access them. Every agent reinvents the math inconsistently. 

**Mosaic decouples logic from consumption. One semantic layer governs dashboards, agents, and
applications simultaneously. Define once, apply everywhere.**

[calculate_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The accuracy trap

Why you can’t ask AI to do math. AI and large language models excel at language. They fail at
aggregation. Asking one to calculate quarterly revenue is a reliable path to hallucinated numbers. 

**Strategy handles the computation. AI handles the explanation. Accurate answers in natural language
without the risk of a model doing math it wasn’t designed for.**

[encrypted_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The security blindspot

What your AI agent can see that it shouldn’t. Most AI data tools bypass row-level security entirely.
A model that can access your data can also summarize it for the wrong person. 

**Every query through Mosaic passes through your existing RBAC rules before a single byte is
fetched. Governed AI isn’t a setting. It’s the architecture.**

[trending_down_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The cost trap

How ungoverned AI queries drain your cloud budget. AI agents that query raw data tables directly are
expensive by design. Each iteration against millions of rows compounds your compute spend invisibly,
until the bill arrives.

**Mosaic’s Smart Caching and push-down optimization routes every query intelligently. Your cloud
costs reflect your decisions, not your agents’ inefficiency.**

[01_Mosaic_Logo_Primary_Color.png]

#### Don’t be a statistic

Join the enterprises building their AI strategy on a governed, universal semantic layer.

[Learn more about Strategy Mosaic][12]

## Built for the entire organization

Mosaic delivers the unified data foundation needed to drive strategy, manage risk, and accelerate
delivery across the organization.

[MicroStrategy Video]
[Build your AI-ready foundation][13]

## The platform your enterprise AI is built on 

Strategy Mosaic is a universal semantic layer that unifies fragmented data systems into a consistent
framework, enabling humans and AI agents to work from a single, synchronized source of truth.

[verified_user_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48 (2).svg]

#### One governed layer for every system

Mosaic connects to 200+ data sources, cloud, on-prem, and hybrid, without moving a byte. Every agent
and application draws from the same governed, trusted definitions. AI that starts on solid ground.

[network_intel_node_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48 (2).svg]

#### From metric to action, in any interface

Because the semantic layer sits beneath every tool, the same governed logic powers dashboards, AI
agents, conversational queries, and embedded applications. One truth. Every surface.

[trending_down_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### Infrastructure-grade query efficiency

Mosaic’s push-down optimization and Smart Caching eliminate redundant processing at the source. The
result is predictable cloud spend even as AI query volume scales.

[Explore Mosaic][14]

## What gets built when AI has a governed foundation 

Strategy Mosaic is the semantic layer that enterprise teams deploy once and build on
indefinitely. Here’s what becomes possible when your AI operates from a single, trusted source of
truth. 

**AI Agents with business context** 

Deploy agents that understand your definitions of revenue, churn, and risk, not generic
approximations. Built on Mosaic, agents use the same logic as your dashboards. 

**Self-service analytics at enterprise scale** 

Business users query governed data directly, in natural language or through dashboards, with no risk
of conflicting metrics or unauthorized access. 

**BI tool migration without logic loss** 

Replace Power BI, BOBJ, or Cognos without rebuilding your metrics. Business logic migrates to Mosaic
once then powers any BI tool you choose. 

**Embedded analytics in any application** 

Embed governed intelligence into your product, customer portal, or internal app. without exposing
the underlying data model or rebuilding access controls. 

## The semantic layer that connects your entire data ecosystem 

Strategy Mosaic sits beneath your existing stack, not on top of it. With 200+ native connectors to
every major cloud, warehouse, and lakehouse, governed semantics deploy instantly across Databricks,
Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, and beyond. No migration. No lock-in. Your data stays
where it is.

## FAQ

What is a universal semantic layer?

A universal semantic layer is the single source of truth for your organization's data definitions,
ensuring that 'Revenue' means exactly the same thing whether it's calculated in Salesforce, analyzed
in Tableau, or processed by your AI models. 

Sitting between your data sources and consumption tools, it translates raw data into trusted
business concepts like 'Active Customer' or 'Margin' with identical calculations and values
guaranteed across every team, every platform, and every use case.  

Unlike semantic layers trapped inside individual BI tools or data warehouses, a universal semantic
layer governs your entire data ecosystem, enforcing consistent definitions regardless of which
cloud, database, or application asks the question. No more finance reporting different numbers than
marketing. No more “Which dashboard is correct?”

How does Strategy Mosaic work?

Strategy Mosaic is a universal semantic layer that connects to your organization's data
sources: including Snowflake, Databrucks, BigQuery, Redshift, Azure, Synapse, SAP, Oracle,
Salesforce, Workday, and on-premises databases, without moving or replicating a single byte. 

Once connected, Mosaic Studio uses AI-powered modeling to automatically generate attributes,
hierarchies, and metrics from your data, delivering in hours what traditionally takes weeks of
manual work. Those definitions are then enforced across every connected BI tool, AI agent, and
application via SQL, DAX, MDX, and REST APIs: meaning Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and custom
applications all work from the same governed definitions automatically. 

Meanwhile, Mosaic Sentinel monitors your data ecosystem in real time, logging every access event,
flagging anomalies, detecting PII exposure, and maintaining a complete audit trail of who accessed
what data, when.

What are the benefits of Strategy Mosaic?
1. **Your Business Logic, Protected Across Every Platform and Every Change**: When your semantic
   layer is built into a single platform, your business definitions are only as portable as that
   vendor allows. Mosaic is a standalone, platform-agnostic layer that governs your definitions of
   Revenue, Margin, and Customer identically across every tool, every cloud, and every AI agent. And
   unlike newer semantic layer tools, Mosaic is backed by 35+ years of enterprise semantic
   technology, meaning it handles the complexity of real enterprise data: fiscal calendars,
   multi-currency hierarchies, time transformations, and security models that most tools are still
   building toward. Your logic is protected today, and it will still be intact when your
   infrastructure changes tomorrow. 
2. **The Only Semantic Layer Built for Everyone, Not Just Engineers**: Most semantic layers are
   built for data engineers and require SQL, YAML, or code to use. Mosaic Studio lets business users
   define new metrics in plain language, build and modify models without writing a single line of
   code, and govern data without filing a ticket. When business users can own their own definitions,
   your data team stops being a bottleneck and starts being a strategic asset. 
3. **Governance That Scales as Fast as Your AI:** As AI agents proliferate across your organization,
   the question isn't just "is my data accurate?" it's "Do I know what my AI accessed, at what cost,
   and whether it touched sensitive data?" Mosaic Sentinel answers all three in real time. It's the
   only semantic layer with governance intelligence built natively into the platform, not added
   on after the fact, giving you the confidence to scale AI without scaling risk.

How does Strategy Mosaic compare to semantic layers built into Snowflake or Databricks?

Snowflake and Databricks are exceptional data platforms. But their semantic layers are built to keep
you inside their ecosystem. Definitions created there don't travel cleanly to Tableau, Power BI, or
your AI agents without custom work.

Mosaic sits above your data platforms as an independent layer. Your definitions of Revenue, Margin,
and Customer are governed identically whether the query comes from a BI tool, an AI agent, or a

## How Algo Supports Your Industry

### Industrial Equipment

Algo empowers industrial manufacturers to master the complexity of long lead times and intricate
Bill of Materials (BOM). Our AI-driven platform provides deep visibility into global supply chains,
allowing firms to synchronize production with volatile demand, optimize aftermarket part inventory,
and ensure seamless execution across diverse product lines.

### Packaged Food & Beverage

Algo helps F&B brands navigate the challenges of perishability and high promotional volatility. By
leveraging real-time data and advanced demand forecasting, our solution optimizes shelf-life
management, reduces waste, and ensures that the right products are in the right locations to meet
shifting consumer tastes and seasonal surges.

### Automotive Suppliers

Algo streamlines the high-stakes world of Just-in-Time (JIT) manufacturing for automotive suppliers.

needed to manage component shortages and logistics bottlenecks while maintaining the strict service
levels required by the global automotive ecosystem.

traceability and inventory accuracy. We help medical device companies balance high service-level
requirements with the need for lean inventory, ensuring life-critical products are available while
navigating complex regulatory and expiration constraints.

### Lubricants & Petrochemicals

Algo masters the volatility of the petrochemical sector by bridging the gap between bulk production
and packaged distribution. Our tools provide real-time visibility into global logistics and demand
fluctuations, enabling brands to optimize packaging schedules and minimize the costs associated with
overstocked or under-distributed specialized fluids.

### Industrial Electronics/Tech

Algo addresses the rapid lifecycles and component sensitivity of the high-tech sector. By
integrating AI-driven forecasting with real-time supply chain signals, we help brands navigate short
product windows and global component shortages, ensuring that innovation reaches the market without
the burden of obsolete inventory.

Algo helps beauty and personal care brands manage extreme SKU proliferation and influencer-driven
demand spikes. Our platform enables agile planning and dynamic inventory placement, ensuring that
fast-moving trends are captured and "hero products" remain in stock across both digital and physical
retail channels.

### Nutraceuticals

Algo supports the nutraceutical industry by optimizing the balance between raw ingredient sourcing
and finished goods distribution. Our solutions provide the transparency needed to manage batch
tracking and fluctuating consumer health trends, ensuring consistent product availability and
high-quality supply chain execution.

### Media & Entertainment

Algo simplifies the distribution of physical and digital media across a fragmented global landscape.
By improving data accuracy and streamlining content operations, our platform helps media companies
optimize inventory for physical merchandise and home entertainment, ensuring that content reaches
the fan base efficiently.

overstocked or under-distributed specialized fluids.

### Industrial Electronics/Tech

Algo addresses the rapid lifecycles and component sensitivity of the high-tech sector. By
integrating AI-driven forecasting with real-time supply chain signals, we help brands navigate short
product windows and global component shortages, ensuring that innovation reaches the market without
the burden of obsolete inventory.

### Personal Care & Cosmetics

Algo helps beauty and personal care brands manage extreme SKU proliferation and influencer-driven
demand spikes. Our platform enables agile planning and dynamic inventory placement, ensuring that
fast-moving trends are captured and "hero products" remain in stock across both digital and physical
retail channels.

### Nutraceuticals

Algo supports the nutraceutical industry by optimizing the balance between raw ingredient sourcing
and finished goods distribution. Our solutions provide the transparency needed to manage batch
tracking and fluctuating consumer health trends, ensuring consistent product availability and
high-quality supply chain execution.

### Media & Entertainment

Algo simplifies the distribution of physical and digital media across a fragmented global landscape.
By improving data accuracy and streamlining content operations, our platform helps media companies
optimize inventory for physical merchandise and home entertainment, ensuring that content reaches
the fan base efficiently.

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

## Built for business. Trusted by IT. Ready for AI.

Intelligent enterprises connect data, analytics, and AI across operations for faster, smarter
decisions. Ready to make the leap?

Alteryx One offers a clear path:


**Give teams an easy way to use enterprise data and AI while IT keeps control over security, scale,
and governance.**


**Reduce manual data prep time by up to 90%, automate analytics, and embed AI across the business.**


**Turn those data-backed decisions into impact with low-/no-code tools, AI assistance, and built-in
governance.**

[Discover Alteryx One][215]
Decision intelligence

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

“What took my team almost a year to complete is now replicable and done in a matter of weeks.”

— Nikita Atkins, Data Science Global Leader, GHD

[ Start Now ][220]
 

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

Put data and AI to work for you. Connect systems, prep and blend data [**up to 100x faster**][221],
automate repeatable work, and keep lineage and controls in place. Alteryx One is a full-spectrum
analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Act

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

 

[Discover Alteryx One][222]

### Data integration and AI-ready preparation

Create a unified view out of ERPs, CRMs, lakes, and files. Alteryx lets you connect enterprise apps
like Oracle and Microsoft without copying data. Automate prep with low-/no-code workflows, add
business context, and enforce governance and lineage to publish AI-ready datasets. Benefits include:
* Improved accuracy
* Faster analysis
* A single source of truth for teams

## Analytics8 Wins “Data Management Innovation Award”

Accelr8 is our AI-enabled framework that brings together more than 20 years of Analytics8
experience. Our clients benefit from access to reusable accelerators, automation, and best practices
to help them move faster with greater confidence and less risk.

## From strategy to measurable business value.

Holmes Corp knew their data had potential but needed help designing the right path forward.

Their success story demonstrates what happens when data strategy is aligned to business growth,
turning existing data into a growth engine.

[Read The Story][116]

## Senior-led teams accountable for outcomes, not just recommendations.

What sets us apart isn’t just what we do — it’s how we deliver. We combine senior talent with our
AI-enabled delivery framework to accelerate execution and reduce risk.

From initial strategy through execution, we ensure data and AI investments generate returns.

## What We Do

Analytics8 is your one partner to turn data and AI ambitions into measurable business value.

### [Strategy & Advisory][121]

We turn data and AI ambition into executable strategy — aligning your priorities, resources, and
investment to accelerate business value and ROI.

### [Modernization][122]

We’ll modernize your data foundation to support solutions that are future ready, scalable, and
responsive — built to evolve as your needs (and data) grows.

### [Data & AI][123]

We deliver end-to-end data and AI services — building, launching, and operationalizing solutions
that turn insight into intelligent action.

### [Data Monetization][124]

We help you turn data into a growth engine — building the data monetization strategy and launching
data products that create new revenue.

[View All Of Our Services][125]

## **We help clients move forward with confidence at every stage of their data and AI journey.**

I couldn’t be happier to witness how our analytics solution has inspired data-driven thinking across
the firm. There are no more ‘out of reach’ questions: we have the context we need to better allocate
our resources and the granularity we need to demonstrate our work’s value in the community.

Kristen Carroll, Principal, Civic Consulting Alliance

[View Our Customer Stories][126]

## Over 1000 clients served

For more than 20 years, we’ve been helping our clients solve their most complex data challenges and
turn their data into action.

## We’re connected across the entire data stack and accountable only to you.

We bring full-stack expertise and close relationships with leading technology providers — giving you
early visibility into what’s next, while staying independent and focused on your needs.

[Our Technology Partners][127]

## Get senior data analytics consultants that stay with you from start to finish.

We are specialists, not generalists, with deep expertise solving complex data and AI challenges
across the full lifecycle.
 
Our senior-led teams bring proven patterns and real-world perspective from thousands of engagements
— helping you avoid common pitfalls, move faster, and focus on what delivers results.

When you work with Analytics8, you get experienced teams that remain accountable to you throughout
your data journey.

### Healthcare

payors, providers, and clinician networks. Our healthcare consulting services help clients survive
and thrive in these challenging times.

More than 1,400 companies around the world use Celonis to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven
processes. Now your agents, humans, and systems can work together to deliver real business outcomes.

## ***The Context Model*** **The missing piece of your Enterprise AI stack**

[Explainer Video][2] [https://celonis-videos.wistia.com/medias/haxy6na0cy][3]

Enterprise AI has blind spots when it comes to how your business operates. The **Celonis Context
Model** combines end-to-end process data, business knowledge, and intelligence. So your people and
agents have the operational clarity they need to reason correctly, decide sensibly, and act
reliably.

[Go to the platform][4]

## ***Solutions*** **Business-critical challenges. Transformational impact.**

[See all solutions][5]

## **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**

Initiative

AI that knows how your business flows.

### **Give AI context**

Empower Enterprise AI with the operational clarity it needs to succeed.

### **Deploy AI strategically**

Identify high-impact AI use cases and measure RoAI.

### **Integrate AI into operations**

Orchestrate people, agents, and existing technologies to drive outcomes.

[Learn more][6]

## **Supply Chain**

Function

AI-powered supply chain transformation.

### **Improve service levels**

Improve on-time in-full delivery, reduce stockouts, and improve supplier reliability.

### **Optimize working capital**

Accelerate slow-moving inventory, and reduce and reallocate excess.

### **Contain costs**

Optimize load consolidation, and reduce operating costs and spot purchasing.

[Learn more][7]

## **Enterprise IT Modernization**

Function

When processes work, IT works.

### **Set modernization strategy**

Align, plan, and execute your modernization strategy using objective information about the state of
your enterprise, not gut instinct.

### **Make enterprise AI work**

Power Enterprise AI with real-time operational context, deploy it where it drives measurable impact,
and integrate it seamlessly into existing systems and workflows.

### **Migrate with confidence**

Simplify your digital core by separating true differentiation from technical debt, reducing
migration risk while sustaining value beyond go-live.

[Learn more][8]

## **Finance and Shared Services**

Function

Take action with less risk, more reward.

### **Improve cash flow**

Optimize payments and accelerate collections.

### **Reduce costs**

Prevent duplicate payments and excess spend.

### **Increase productivity**

Automate actions and improve cycle times.

[Learn more][9]

## **Process Excellence**

Initiative

When processes work, everything works.

### **Analyze**

Understand how your processes truly run. Identify the most impactful opportunities to implement
improvements and deploy AI. Run process simulations, predictions, and what-if scenarios.

### **Design**

Redesign operations to integrate Enterprise AI. Re-engineer processes based on deep process insight.
Define workflows, outcomes, guardrails, and best practices.

### **Operate**

Continuously monitor process performance, adherence, and agent activity. Orchestrate AI to work
alongside people and systems.

[Learn more][10]

## **Success stories**

[See all][11]

Customer Story

### **Fujitsu**

Fujitsu uses Celonis to gain full transparency into inventory levels and AI-enhanced recommendations

# ***Make Enterprise AI work.***

highlight

More than 1,400 companies around the world use Celonis to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven
processes. Now your agents, humans, and systems can work together to deliver real business outcomes.

## ***The Context Model*** **The missing piece of your Enterprise AI stack**

[Explainer Video][2] [https://celonis-videos.wistia.com/medias/haxy6na0cy][3]

Enterprise AI has blind spots when it comes to how your business operates. The **Celonis Context
Model** combines end-to-end process data, business knowledge, and intelligence. So your people and
agents have the operational clarity they need to reason correctly, decide sensibly, and act
reliably.

[Go to the platform][4]

## ***Solutions*** **Business-critical challenges. Transformational impact.**

[See all solutions][5]

## **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**

Initiative

AI that knows how your business flows.

### **Give AI context**

Empower Enterprise AI with the operational clarity it needs to succeed.

### **Deploy AI strategically**

Identify high-impact AI use cases and measure RoAI.

### **Integrate AI into operations**

Orchestrate people, agents, and existing technologies to drive outcomes.

[Learn more][6]

## **Supply Chain**

Function

AI-powered supply chain transformation.

### **Improve service levels**

Improve on-time in-full delivery, reduce stockouts, and improve supplier reliability.

### **Optimize working capital**

Accelerate slow-moving inventory, and reduce and reallocate excess.

### **Contain costs**

Optimize load consolidation, and reduce operating costs and spot purchasing.

[Learn more][7]

## **Enterprise IT Modernization**

Function

When processes work, IT works.

### **Set modernization strategy**

Align, plan, and execute your modernization strategy using objective information about the state of
your enterprise, not gut instinct.

### **Make enterprise AI work**

Power Enterprise AI with real-time operational context, deploy it where it drives measurable impact,
and integrate it seamlessly into existing systems and workflows.

### **Migrate with confidence**

Simplify your digital core by separating true differentiation from technical debt, reducing
migration risk while sustaining value beyond go-live.

[Learn more][8]

## **Finance and Shared Services**

Function

Take action with less risk, more reward.

### **Improve cash flow**

Optimize payments and accelerate collections.

### **Reduce costs**

Prevent duplicate payments and excess spend.

### **Increase productivity**

Automate actions and improve cycle times.

[Learn more][9]

## **Process Excellence**

Initiative

When processes work, everything works.

### **Analyze**

Understand how your processes truly run. Identify the most impactful opportunities to implement
improvements and deploy AI. Run process simulations, predictions, and what-if scenarios.

### **Design**

Redesign operations to integrate Enterprise AI. Re-engineer processes based on deep process insight.
Define workflows, outcomes, guardrails, and best practices.

### **Operate**

Continuously monitor process performance, adherence, and agent activity. Orchestrate AI to work
alongside people and systems.

[Learn more][10]

[See all][11]

about when to stock-up, re-allocate, and refrain from buying materials.

9c-c8bbdbd0b5b2/original/as/uniper-customer-story-highlight-2.jpg][15]

Customer Story

cross-border payments to enabling transparency, AI, and automation.

[Read more][16]

[https://delivery-p141552-e1488202.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:578666d7-779d-4648-bb
b7-18600d8bfe26/original/as/standard-bank-customer-story-highlight%20(1).jpg][17]

[Read more][18]

### Priorities guiding our path forward

We’re putting style, design and value at the center of everything we do. And four clear priorities
are guiding strategic choices aimed at delighting guests and driving profitable growth in 2026 and
beyond.

[ Learn more ][179]
[The exterior of a Target store with large glass windows.]

We're here to help all families discover the joy of everyday life.

Since 1962, Target has been a leader in style and design, bringing our only-at-Target assortment and
guest experience to more than 2,000 communities coast to coast.

[Go to About][180]

[A Target team member walks with a guest in the electronics section of a Target store.]

Work somewhere you love.

From stores to supply chain facilities, we’re looking for new team members like you.

[Go to Careers][181]

[Three Target volunteers work together in a garden.]

An equitable & regenerative future.

# Infrastructure Without Compromise

Reliable data center & cloud solutions.

[ Get Started ][215]

## Purpose-Built Data Centers for Today's Enterprise Demands

### Enhanced Security

Our facilities have 24×7 CCTV monitoring, dual authentication entry, and individually secured
cabinets for added security.

### Compliance

With SSAE 18 SOC 2 certification, and PCI SAQ-D compliance, our facilities give you peace of mind.

### Uptime Assurance

Nationwide SLAs and N+1 or greater facilities, backed by generators, ensure protection for your
critical infrastructure.

### The Inner Circle

DartPoints’ carrier-neutrals facilities provide an ecosystem of choice for connectivity to networks
and clouds empowering your growth.

## Find The Nearest Dartpoints Data Center

DartPoints strategically places data centers in mid-sized markets, addressing diverse and unique
regional needs and fostering economic growth.

Proximity to end users ensures low latency and reliable disaster recovery, reinforcing DartPoints’
role in providing colocation and cloud services to support business growth and resilience in these
markets.

## Let's Connect

Here is Our Simple Three-Step Process for New Clients

### SCHEDULE A DISCOVERY CALL

Let’s have a conversation about your goals, needs, and expectations. This is our shared opportunity
to discuss the full scope of work for your project so that DartPoints can provide you with the best
possible solution.

### GET A TAILORED SOLUTION

When it comes to handling your data, DartPoints knows that one size does not fit all. DartPoints has
customized solutions for your business support. DartPoints considers your budget, timeline, and
desired outcomes.

### ENJOY PEACE OF MIND

Rest easy – DartPoints' powerful security measures, strict privacy protocols, and vigilance against
potential threats ensure your data is safe and secure. Focus on running your business and leave the
rest to our team of trusted experts.

[ Book a Discovery Call with us Today ][227]
Delivery with a Personal Touch

## Consistent Delivery

## Consistent Delivery

##### Reliable data center & cloud solutions | Technical experts with regional roots | Personalized
##### support

At DartPoints, we’re more than a data center – we’re your dedicated partner, offering custom,
reliable, and scalable solutions. Our regional knowledge advantage supports your specific data
requirements.


The DartPoints team goes the extra mile, ensuring customer satisfaction by anticipating trends and
providing intelligent data solutions. Unlike major providers, we maintain a personal touch with
local data centers, allowing direct communication with the right person for your needs.

## What Sets Dartpoints Apart

### Our Technical Expertise

DartPoints excels in collaborative migration services, easing IT staffing challenges and optimizing
CAPEX/OPEX management for a comprehensive business solution without the need to release complete
control.

### Regional Roots, Tailored Service

Our extensive regional and industry expertise ensures a profound understanding of your business
intricacies, enabling us to offer personalized services that foster a high-touch, collaborative
approach often overlooked by larger entities.

### Reliability and Security

Our top priority is securing your data through multi-layered protocols and continuous monitoring,
ensuring a 99.999% uptime SLA. Our low-latency connectivity provides seamless access and
unparalleled performance.

### We’re Ready When You’re Ready

Contact the DartPoints colocation and cloud solution experts for assistance with colocation, cloud,
cyber security, backup services, and more. Experience the difference of working with a company that
prioritizes exceeding customer expectations.

[ Request a Consultation ][228]

## What Our Clients Say About Us

“We are touching sensitive data, so many of our clients request audits to make sure our hosting
facility is secure. By partnering with DartPoints, it’s easy to provide that reassurance to our
customers that we can meet the security and uptime they need to keep their critical business data
flowing.”

Jason Lungarini
CEO and Founding Partner of FusionPoint

“We saved a lot of money by not having to house two different data replication sites. From
equipment, time and infrastructure we saved a considerable amount of money all around.”

Sherry Lawrence
Director of Information Services at Rogers & Brown

“The IT expertise and knowledge DartPoints provides is something that we have come to rely on in our
partnership, which is very beneficial, particularly for a smaller business like ours. With
DartPoints, I know that I can pick up the phone and call the NOC anytime to support our underlying
infrastructure.”

Jason Ray
President of SimplyHome

“DartPoints made the migration process easy and painless; they even went above and beyond to speed
up replication of our data to ensure a shortened window of vulnerability. They have been there every
step of the way to help us develop a best-fit solution as our business’ needs have grown.”

Bobby Keller
IT Infrastructure Manager at Dayton Superior

“The legal field is so dependent on technology—from email to our document repository to the various
applications and online legal tools we use—working with a provider who delivers always on systems
and stability is critical to our practice.”

Rich Wills
CIO of KMK Law

and clouds empowering your growth.

intricacies, enabling us to offer personalized services that foster a high-touch, collaborative

unparalleled performance.

As the market evolves and adapts to new realities, businesses must also adapt to meet these new
challenges. E2open has the solution: a unified, end-to-end software platform that gives you more
control over your entire value chain, from the factory floor to your customer’s hands.

[ Intelligent and Unified Applications ][106]

### Everything you need to optimize your supply chain, under one roof

Our solution suites enable true visibility and collaboration across all of your supply chain
touchpoints, including planning, supply, global trade, logistics, and channel. Our purpose-built
platform lets you manage it all from one place.

### Channel

Visibility, collaboration, and control for optimal channel performance across all tiers

### Planning

Connected planning across all ecosystem partners, with real-time data and field-proven artificial
intelligence

### Global Trade

Confident screening, cross-border compliance, and duty filing backed by the world’s most
comprehensive trade content

### Logistics

Connected planning and execution for efficient movement of goods across all modes, legs, and regions

### Supply

Optimal supply through complete visibility and collaboration with all tiers of suppliers and
outsourced production partners

[ Harmony® Unified User Experience ][107]

## The digital window into your supply chain

How do you design a platform to serve the extensive needs of a global supply chain? You go to the
source. Our interface is the result of technical innovation anchored in extensive user-based
research across industries and supply chain functions.

##### Intuitive and modern user experience

Harmony is the result of technical innovation anchored in extensive user-based research across
industries and supply chain functions.

##### Streamlined processes and workflows

Harmony provides a common user experience across all e2open’s offerings. Key business processes are
streamlined via actionable views and integrated workflows.

##### End-to-end visibility and collaboration

By integrating business processes and breaking down traditional information and decision-making
silos, Harmony enables better planning, optimization and execution, as well as end-to-end supply
chain visibility and collaboration.

[The connected supply chain platform to transform your business.]

Through our unifying, end-to-end, cloud-native technology platform and interconnected network of
manufacturing, logistics, and distribution partners, we empower worldwide commerce and generate

## Insight into every step of your product journey

As the market evolves and adapts to new realities, businesses must also adapt to meet these new
challenges. E2open has the solution: a unified, end-to-end software platform that gives you more
control over your entire value chain, from the factory floor to your customer’s hands.

[Explore our solutions][105]

* Intelligent and Unified Applications
* Harmony® Unified User Experience
* E2net Open Partner Network

[ Intelligent and Unified Applications ][106]

### Everything you need to optimize your supply chain, under one roof

Our solution suites enable true visibility and collaboration across all of your supply chain
touchpoints, including planning, supply, global trade, logistics, and channel. Our purpose-built
platform lets you manage it all from one place.

### Channel

Visibility, collaboration, and control for optimal channel performance across all tiers

### Planning

Connected planning across all ecosystem partners, with real-time data and field-proven artificial
intelligence

### Global Trade

Confident screening, cross-border compliance, and duty filing backed by the world’s most
comprehensive trade content

### Logistics

Connected planning and execution for efficient movement of goods across all modes, legs, and regions

### Supply

Optimal supply through complete visibility and collaboration with all tiers of suppliers and
outsourced production partners

[ Harmony® Unified User Experience ][107]

## The digital window into your supply chain

How do you design a platform to serve the extensive needs of a global supply chain? You go to the
source. Our interface is the result of technical innovation anchored in extensive user-based
research across industries and supply chain functions.

##### Intuitive and modern user experience

Harmony is the result of technical innovation anchored in extensive user-based research across
industries and supply chain functions.

##### Streamlined processes and workflows

Harmony provides a common user experience across all e2open’s offerings. Key business processes are
streamlined via actionable views and integrated workflows.

##### End-to-end visibility and collaboration

By integrating business processes and breaking down traditional information and decision-making
silos, Harmony enables better planning, optimization and execution, as well as end-to-end supply
chain visibility and collaboration.

[The connected supply chain platform to transform your business.]
[ E2net Open Partner Network ][108]

## Leverage the world’s largest network of interconnected partners

Through our unifying, end-to-end, cloud-native technology platform and interconnected network of
manufacturing, logistics, and distribution partners, we empower worldwide commerce and generate
greater supply chain productivity while mitigating business risks and minimizing costs.

[ How to Ensure a Successful 3PL Implementation ][77]

In our previous post, we talked about the importance of defining operational goals and requirements
and the need for a thorough partner evaluation and selection. While choosing the right partner is
important, the integration and go live process is critical to ensure success. In this blogpost, we
will focus on the implementation, which we have broken out into 3 steps, Mapping Integration Points
for Systems and Data, Transition Management and Go Live, and Ongoing Management and Continuous

[Read more →][78]
[ How to Choose the Right 3PL Partner ][79]

Integrating warehouse operations with a 3PL provider offers several advantages for supply chain
management, like efficiency improvements, cost savings, flexible labor, scalability, access to
specialized expertise, and enhanced customer service. To achieve these improvements, it is
imperative that the right partner is selected and the implementation is successful. At Establish, we
follow a detailed 5 step approach when selecting and integrating a new 3PL provider. In this post,
we will dive into the first 2 steps to and discuss some of the key considerations for selecting the
right 3PL partner.

[Read more →][80]
[ A Guide to Warehouse Automation for Every Warehouse ][81]

The evolution of technology has been marked by the emergence of technologies that were once
considered impossible. The first televisions and computers were bulky, expensive, and limited in
their capabilities. However, they paved the way for the development of more advanced devices such as
smartphones and tablets. These devices are not only more affordable but also more accessible to a
wider audience, enabling them to benefit from the features that were once exclusive to the
privileged few. The automation landscape has undergone a similar transformation in recent years. The
traditional approach of relying on large, robust, and rather expensive solutions has given way to a
more modular, scalable, and affordable approach. This shift has enabled smaller companies to
leverage the many advantages of automation that were once only available to larger companies. In
this blogpost, we will focus on the advantages of automation, introduce the main technologies, and
introduce some operational and budgetary considerations, before jumping into some specific examples.

[Read more →][82]
[ Warehouse Optimization: Maximizing Space Utilization and Reducing Costs ][83]

In the world of supply chain management, warehouses play a crucial role in storing and distributing
goods efficiently. However, many companies struggle with limited space and rising operational costs,
which can hinder productivity and profitability. The key to overcoming these challenges lies in
warehouse optimization. By maximizing space utilization and reducing costs, businesses can unlock
significant benefits and gain a competitive edge in the market. In this post, we will explore
practical strategies and actionable tips to optimize your warehouse operations and get the most out
of your warehouse or distribution center.

[Read more →][84]
[ Warehouse Scanning Technology: Additional Options to Elevate Your Warehouse Operation ][85]

Warehouse operations are continuously evolving to meet the growing demands for efficiency, accuracy,
and speed in order fulfillment. While handheld RF scanners have been a staple in warehouse
environments for data capture, advancements in technology have introduced alternatives that offer
enhanced capabilities and improved productivity. In this post, we will explore alternatives that are
redefining warehouse operations, surpassing the limitations of handheld RF scanners and opening
doors to new levels of efficiency and automation.

[Read more →][86]

[ How to Choose the Right 3PL Partner ][79]

Integrating warehouse operations with a 3PL provider offers several advantages for supply chain
management, like efficiency improvements, cost savings, flexible labor, scalability, access to
specialized expertise, and enhanced customer service. To achieve these improvements, it is
imperative that the right partner is selected and the implementation is successful. At Establish, we
follow a detailed 5 step approach when selecting and integrating a new 3PL provider. In this post,
we will dive into the first 2 steps to and discuss some of the key considerations for selecting the
right 3PL partner.

[Read more →][80]
[ A Guide to Warehouse Automation for Every Warehouse ][81]

The evolution of technology has been marked by the emergence of technologies that were once
considered impossible. The first televisions and computers were bulky, expensive, and limited in
their capabilities. However, they paved the way for the development of more advanced devices such as
smartphones and tablets. These devices are not only more affordable but also more accessible to a
wider audience, enabling them to benefit from the features that were once exclusive to the
privileged few. The automation landscape has undergone a similar transformation in recent years. The
traditional approach of relying on large, robust, and rather expensive solutions has given way to a
more modular, scalable, and affordable approach. This shift has enabled smaller companies to
leverage the many advantages of automation that were once only available to larger companies. In
this blogpost, we will focus on the advantages of automation, introduce the main technologies, and
introduce some operational and budgetary considerations, before jumping into some specific examples.

[Read more →][82]
[ Warehouse Optimization: Maximizing Space Utilization and Reducing Costs ][83]

In the world of supply chain management, warehouses play a crucial role in storing and distributing
goods efficiently. However, many companies struggle with limited space and rising operational costs,
which can hinder productivity and profitability. The key to overcoming these challenges lies in
warehouse optimization. By maximizing space utilization and reducing costs, businesses can unlock
significant benefits and gain a competitive edge in the market. In this post, we will explore
practical strategies and actionable tips to optimize your warehouse operations and get the most out
of your warehouse or distribution center.

[Read more →][84]
[ Warehouse Scanning Technology: Additional Options to Elevate Your Warehouse Operation ][85]

Warehouse operations are continuously evolving to meet the growing demands for efficiency, accuracy,
and speed in order fulfillment. While handheld RF scanners have been a staple in warehouse
environments for data capture, advancements in technology have introduced alternatives that offer
enhanced capabilities and improved productivity. In this post, we will explore alternatives that are
redefining warehouse operations, surpassing the limitations of handheld RF scanners and opening
doors to new levels of efficiency and automation.

[Read more →][86]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

# Start decisions that stay connected.

The difference between good planning and great outcome is every decision in between.

Every supply chain decision creates ripple effects across suppliers, inventory, production,
logistics, and customers. Kinaxis combines context-aware AI and purpose-built supply chain agents to
understand those impacts, helping you make faster, more connected decisions and orchestrate
execution as conditions change.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Metro Supply Chain?

Metro Supply Chain is a strategic supply chain solutions partner that provides end-to-end
third-party logistics (3PL) services across North America and the UK. With over 50 years of
experience, Metro Supply Chain helps businesses adapt and grow through innovative, tech-enabled
logistics, from warehousing and transportation to last-mile delivery and supply chain consulting.

How big is Metro Supply Chain?

With a presence in over 190 sites across Canada, the US and the UK, Metro Supply Chain is one of
Canada’s largest privately owned supply chain companies, recognized for its strategic excellence and
strong community values. Powered by advanced systems and technologies, its integrated services
support complex distribution needs across 22.5 million square feet of managed space.

What does 3PL stand for?

3PL stands for third-party logistics. It refers to outsourcing logistics functions such as
warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment and transportation to a specialist provider.

Why is Metro Supply Chain a preferred third-party logistics provider?

With a focus on innovation, customer service, and tailored strategies, Metro Supply Chain is a
trusted partner for brands looking to transform their supply chain.

What measures does Metro Supply Chain take to ensure the safety of the products?

We follow strict quality control protocols, leverage secure facilities, and use technology-enabled
tracking to protect goods in transit and storage.

Can Metro Supply Chain handle international logistics and customs clearance?

Yes. Our global network and customs expertise ensure smooth cross-border operations and compliance.

Does Metro Supply Chain provide real-time shipment tracking and visibility?

Absolutely. Our advanced systems provide full transparency and proactive alerts across all
touchpoints of your supply chain.

How can I find my package or get delivery support from Metro Supply Chain?

For delivery support, visit our [contact us][97] page and select 'find my package' from the
drop-down.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Metro Supply Chain?

Metro Supply Chain is a strategic supply chain solutions partner that provides end-to-end
third-party logistics (3PL) services across North America and the UK. With over 50 years of
experience, Metro Supply Chain helps businesses adapt and grow through innovative, tech-enabled
logistics, from warehousing and transportation to last-mile delivery and supply chain consulting.

How big is Metro Supply Chain?

With a presence in over 190 sites across Canada, the US and the UK, Metro Supply Chain is one of
Canada’s largest privately owned supply chain companies, recognized for its strategic excellence and
strong community values. Powered by advanced systems and technologies, its integrated services
support complex distribution needs across 22.5 million square feet of managed space.

What does 3PL stand for?

3PL stands for third-party logistics. It refers to outsourcing logistics functions such as
warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment and transportation to a specialist provider.

Why is Metro Supply Chain a preferred third-party logistics provider?

With a focus on innovation, customer service, and tailored strategies, Metro Supply Chain is a
trusted partner for brands looking to transform their supply chain.

What measures does Metro Supply Chain take to ensure the safety of the products?

We follow strict quality control protocols, leverage secure facilities, and use technology-enabled
tracking to protect goods in transit and storage.

Can Metro Supply Chain handle international logistics and customs clearance?

Yes. Our global network and customs expertise ensure smooth cross-border operations and compliance.

Does Metro Supply Chain provide real-time shipment tracking and visibility?

Absolutely. Our advanced systems provide full transparency and proactive alerts across all
touchpoints of your supply chain.

How can I find my package or get delivery support from Metro Supply Chain?

For delivery support, visit our [contact us][97] page and select 'find my package' from the
drop-down.

How do you manage AI project implementation?

We use agile project management with weekly sprints, clear milestones, and transparent reporting.
Every project has a dedicated lead, a shared roadmap, and bi-weekly demos so you always know where
things stand.

What AI technologies do you specialize in?

We specialize in machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and large language
models including GPT, Claude, and custom fine-tuned models. We also work with agentic AI frameworks
for autonomous workflow orchestration.

How do you ensure AI project success?

Success is measured through clear KPIs: cost reduction (30%+), revenue increase, efficiency gains,
and user satisfaction. We set these metrics upfront and report against them continuously.

What is your typical project timeline?

Most AI readiness engagements run for 4 weeks: week 1 for assessment, week 2 for integration, week 3
for training, and week 4 for optimisation and handover. Custom software and platform builds are
scoped per project.

How do you handle AI project risks?

We mitigate risks through thorough testing, data validation, and gradual rollout. This includes A/B
testing, compliance checks, security audits, and rollback plans for every deployment.

What makes PADISO different from other agencies?

We combine deep technical expertise with proven methodologies. Our team focuses on rapid deployment,
measurable ROI, and hands-on implementation rather than just advisory. We build alongside you, not
from the sidelines.

## Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about working with PADISO. Can't find what you're looking for? Get in
touch.

[ Contact us ][25]
How do you manage AI project implementation?

We use agile project management with weekly sprints, clear milestones, and transparent reporting.
Every project has a dedicated lead, a shared roadmap, and bi-weekly demos so you always know where
things stand.

What AI technologies do you specialize in?

We specialize in machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and large language
models including GPT, Claude, and custom fine-tuned models. We also work with agentic AI frameworks
for autonomous workflow orchestration.

How do you ensure AI project success?

Success is measured through clear KPIs: cost reduction (30%+), revenue increase, efficiency gains,
and user satisfaction. We set these metrics upfront and report against them continuously.

What is your typical project timeline?

Most AI readiness engagements run for 4 weeks: week 1 for assessment, week 2 for integration, week 3
for training, and week 4 for optimisation and handover. Custom software and platform builds are
scoped per project.

How do you handle AI project risks?

We mitigate risks through thorough testing, data validation, and gradual rollout. This includes A/B
testing, compliance checks, security audits, and rollback plans for every deployment.

What makes PADISO different from other agencies?

We combine deep technical expertise with proven methodologies. Our team focuses on rapid deployment,
measurable ROI, and hands-on implementation rather than just advisory. We build alongside you, not
from the sidelines.

add crypto payment flows directly to its own website without redirecting users elsewhere.

conversations at our booth came back to processing: invoicing that's easy to set up, withdrawals
that run automatically, and an analytics dashboard that shows exactly where fees go.

# IGNITE COFFEE’S FUTURE

[Get to know the SCA][106]

COFFEE BUSINESS EDUCATION

## You already know coffee. Now learn the business.

A new 12-week, online, cohort program designed to help coffee shop owners and managers level up
their business — from launch to growth. Built for working professionals, by tenured experts.

[Learn more][107]

EDUCATION

## Grow your coffee career with the SCA

The SCA offers globally recognized coffee education designed to support career growth at every
level. From foundational learning to advanced certifications, these courses are used by coffee
professionals and businesses worldwide.

[Start learning][108]
**80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR** 89 COUNTRIES **2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS** 16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES
**4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS** 80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR **89 COUNTRIES** 2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS
**16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES** 4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS

JUST ANNOUNCED

## Introducing Master of Specialty Coffee

A credential designed for the professionals who have spent their careers working across every
dimension of this industry.

The highest distinction in coffee.

[Learn more][109]
[SCA CEO stands with representatives of the Seoul coffee community at launch event for Master of
Specialty Coffee in May 2026]

### More programs to grow your skills

**Gain skills with SCA diplomas**

Structured learning across key areas of specialty coffee.

[Learn more][110]

**Get a Q Grader License**

Certification focused on coffee quality evaluation and cupping.

[Learn more][111]

**Learn with Coffee Business Education**

Training designed for coffee shop owners and business operators.

[Learn more][112]

SCA EVENTS

## Find coffee events
## around the world

SCA events include World of Coffee, World Coffee Championships, and global industry gatherings.
These events bring professionals together to connect, compete, and stay updated on the new products
and latest developments in coffee.

[Explore events][113]

WORLD COFFEE CHAMPIONSHIPS

## Three New
## World Champions!

Find out more about the newly crowned best brewer, roaster and coffee mixologists.

[ Learn more][114]

### Upcoming events across the globe
* ## World of Coffee Panama
  
  October 23 - 25, 2026
  Calle Gral. Juan D. Peron,
  Panam

# IGNITE COFFEE’S FUTURE

[Get to know the SCA][106]

COFFEE BUSINESS EDUCATION

## You already know coffee. Now learn the business.

A new 12-week, online, cohort program designed to help coffee shop owners and managers level up
their business — from launch to growth. Built for working professionals, by tenured experts.

[Learn more][107]

EDUCATION

## Grow your coffee career with the SCA

The SCA offers globally recognized coffee education designed to support career growth at every
level. From foundational learning to advanced certifications, these courses are used by coffee
professionals and businesses worldwide.

[Start learning][108]
**80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR** 89 COUNTRIES **2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS** 16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES
**4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS** 80,000+ LEARNERS/YEAR **89 COUNTRIES** 2,000+ AUTHORIZED SCA TRAINERS
**16 SKILLS-BASED MODULES** 4 CAREER-DRIVEN DIPLOMAS

JUST ANNOUNCED

## Introducing Master of Specialty Coffee

A credential designed for the professionals who have spent their careers working across every
dimension of this industry.

The highest distinction in coffee.

[Learn more][109]
[SCA CEO stands with representatives of the Seoul coffee community at launch event for Master of
Specialty Coffee in May 2026]

### More programs to grow your skills

**Gain skills with SCA diplomas**

Structured learning across key areas of specialty coffee.

[Learn more][110]

**Get a Q Grader License**

Certification focused on coffee quality evaluation and cupping.

[Learn more][111]

**Learn with Coffee Business Education**

Training designed for coffee shop owners and business operators.

[Learn more][112]

SCA EVENTS

## Find coffee events
## around the world

SCA events include World of Coffee, World Coffee Championships, and global industry gatherings.
These events bring professionals together to connect, compete, and stay updated on the new products
and latest developments in coffee.

[Explore events][113]

WORLD COFFEE CHAMPIONSHIPS

## Three New
## World Champions!

Find out more about the newly crowned best brewer, roaster and coffee mixologists.

[ Learn more][114]

### Upcoming events across the globe
* ## World of Coffee Panama
  
  October 23 - 25, 2026
  Calle Gral. Juan D. Peron,
  Panam

answers grounded in how that trading
partner actually operates. 

### MAX Monitor

Know what's breaking before
your trading partner calls. 

MAX Monitor keeps watch across 300,000+
trading relationships and billions of
transactions, tracking workflow requirements
and exceptions across the network. It helps
automate routine work, surfaces critical
insights proactively, and supports continuous
operations even outside business hours.

### MAX Connect

Bring network intelligence into
the systems you already use.  

MAX Connect supports Model Context
Protocol, so network intelligence can flow
directly into your ERP, your AI agents, and
your existing workflows. You don't build a
separate AI stack. You connect your stack
to the most intelligent supply chain
network in the industry. 

[Learn More about MAX][98]

### Top Retailers Win with SPS Commerce.

The majority of NRF's 2025 top 10 Retailers choose SPS Commerce.

### Trusted by the Fastest Growing Brands.

65% of [Bain & Company's 2026][99] Insurgent Brands choose SPS Commerce.

# Supply Chain Analytics: The Hub for Tools, Insights & Strategies


Supply chain analytics gives you the edge by turning data into smarter decisions. From forecasting
demand to reducing risks, it makes supply chains faster, leaner, and more resilient. Here you’ll
find up-to-date tools, strategies, and trends shaping 2025 and beyond — everything you need to stay
ahead.



[Explore Tools ][23]

## What is Supply Chain Analytics?

Supply chain analytics is the practice of using data, statistical models, and advanced technologies
to improve decisions across the supply chain. It goes beyond tracking goods — it helps organizations
forecast demand, optimize inventory, reduce costs, and respond quickly to risks or disruptions.


At its core, supply chain analytics is built on four types of analysis: **descriptive analytics**
(understanding what happened), **diagnostic analytics** (finding out why it happened), **predictive
analytics** (anticipating what will happen), and **prescriptive analytics** (recommending the best
action to take). Together, these approaches turn raw data into actionable insights.


As global supply chains face increasing uncertainty, efficiency pressures, and sustainability
demands, supply chain analytics has become essential for competitiveness and resilience.

**What do you mean by supply chain analytics?**

Supply chain analytics refers to the use of data, statistical models, and digital tools to improve
the efficiency and effectiveness of supply chain operations. It transforms raw data from
procurement, production, inventory, and logistics into actionable insights. Companies use analytics
to forecast demand, reduce costs, manage risks, and optimize customer service. In short, it turns
supply chains into data-driven ecosystems that make faster and smarter decisions.

**What supply chain analytics certifications are recognized?**

Popular ones include:
**APICS Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM) – focuses on analytics-driven
inventory and planning.
Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) – a broad certification covering analytics applications
across global supply chains.
Six Sigma Green/Black Belt – often used for analytics in process improvement.
MITx MicroMasters in Supply Chain Management – a rigorous online program with strong data and
analytics modules.
Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) – not supply chain-specific but widely respected in analytics
roles.

higher-level analytics positions. You can explore our [Top Certifications for Supply Chain
Professionals][71] for a full list.

chain management.

looking for quantitative approaches.

for demand forecasting and inventory planning.

practical applications.

10–20% lower supply chain costs through improved forecasting and optimization.
15% better inventory utilization, reducing excess stock and freeing working capital.
Improved service levels, with on-time delivery rates climbing by 20–30%.
Faster response to disruptions, from weather events to supplier breakdowns, thanks to predictive
modeling.

necessity for expansion across various key regions. UNIS promptly extended its services into three
major markets, allowing this formidable megawatt industry leader to concentrate on its core
